findings.scenario: Type-checking the new test with the repository's tsconfig.test.json fails because ScopeResolutionIndexes is imported from a package that does not export it.
findings.evidence: A focused TypeScript semantic check using tsconfig.test.json reports TS2305 at line 16: Module 'gitnexus-shared' has no exported member 'ScopeResolutionIndexes'. The type is defined in gitnexus/src/core/ingestion/model/scope-resolution-indexes.ts; the production resolver imports it from that module. Vitest transpilation and the source-only CI typecheck do not detect this test import error.
findings.recommendation: Remove ScopeResolutionIndexes from the gitnexus-shared import and import it as a type from ../../src/core/ingestion/model/scope-resolution-indexes.js.
